# The extension archive bridge can receive an empty message list

The `messages.archive` schema declares an array of MessageId values, requires `messagesMove`, and sets no `minItems`. The checked `collectMessagesInFolders()` loops over supplied IDs, looks up each actual header, throws for a missing header, and groups unique headers by their actual folder. With an empty ID array it returns an empty map without looking up a header.

The archive method rejects external messages whose folder is missing, collects the header sets, then awaits a resolve-only promise driven by an archiver's `oncomplete`. It invokes `archiveMessages(messages)` without using its async promise. With the checked empty array path, `archiveMessages()` returns before listener registration or `oncomplete`, so the extension's own callback bridge has no completion action.

A controlled probe at 2026-10-13T15:19:27.697Z evaluated the exact collection helper, archive method, and archiver body. Node.js v26.3.1 ran on macOS arm64. After a full event-loop turn, the outer promise remained pending, with zero registrations and zero callbacks. DefaultMap, message manager, and privileged services were substitutes. Schema parsing confirmed no declared minimum item count. The actual extension validation framework and a running Thunderbird extension were not used. This proves the source path and the controlled result; it does not certify the live API failure.

Non-empty invalid IDs throw synchronously inside the outer method's try/catch and become `ExtensionError`. Folder-preparation rejection from the archiver is a different path: that discarded async promise is not wired to the resolve-only outer promise. Copy failure logs and still invokes `oncomplete`, so this callback alone also cannot tell the extension that copying failed. There is no cancellation hook in these three checked bodies.

## Evidence

- [mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json:1663–1677](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/components/extensions/schemas/messages.json#L1663-L1677): `messages.archive schema`.
- [mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-messages.js:1004–1018](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-messages.js#L1004-L1018): `collectMessagesInFolders`.
- [mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-messages.js:1985–2006](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-messages.js#L1985-L2006): `messages.archive`.
- [mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs:83–90](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs#L83-L90): `empty input and concurrency guard`.
- [mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs:186–194](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs#L186-L194): `completion callback`.
- [mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs:327–335](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/blob/87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799/mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs#L327-L335): `copy failure completion`.
